title: Consolidate design tokens and normalize responsive variants across controls
creator: Maya Rojas
description: Audit and reduce token duplication across the Figma library, unify naming for spacing/typography tokens, and normalize responsive component variants (buttons, input controls, table rows, chart legends) so they obey consistent auto-layout rules and publish clean, single-source components for the designer/engineer handoff.
acceptance_criteria: All duplicated color/spacing/typography tokens consolidated into the canonical token page with an audit log documenting removed aliases.
Primary control components (Button, Input, Select, Datagrid Row, Chart Legend) have 1 canonical variant set each with explicit responsive ordering and clear variant naming.
Auto-layout constraints standardized: padding uses named tokens, alignment rules are explicit, and resizing behavior is predictable across common frame sizes.
Figma library has a single published file (versioned) with release notes; downstream files are updated to the new published components or flagged in migration guide.
Engineering has a mapped token export (JSON) and a short migration checklist for frontend owners; at least two internal teams sign off on component behavior.
No visual regressions in the component snapshot report beyond documented, intentional changes.
tasks: Run tokens audit script and generate token usage CSV (owner: Maya)
Map alias tokens to canonical tokens and propose rename mapping (owner: Oliver)
Refactor Button variants to responsive-first order and remove legacy icon-only variants (owner: Design)
Normalize auto-layout on Table Row and Chart Legend components and add clear resizing recipes (owner: Design)
Publish new Figma library draft and circulate migration guide to frontend teams (owner: Design + Eng)
Open GitHub PR to update token export and bump design-system package (owner: Engineering)
Collect signoffs from Growth and Platform teams (owner: PM)
Run snapshot comparison and log any unexpected regressions (owner: QA)
Schedule a short rollout demo in weekly design sync and record video (owner: Maya)
Follow-up cleanup: archive deprecated components and add deprecation warnings in file (owner: Design)
Prepare release notes for design-system-2025.03 (owner: Maya)
comments: 2025-02-14 Maya Rojas: Kickoff — ran initial token audit, found ~42 spacing aliases and several color duplicates between 'core' and 'legacy' pages. Uploaded CSV: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-token-audit-csv

2025-02-20 Maya Rojas: Design review with PM and Eng. Decided to remove icon-only Button variants and instead offer an 'icon' prop documented in variant naming. See Figma frames: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/Redwood-Design-System?node-id=402%3A1
2025-02-24 Design Sync (notes): Agreed standard auto-layout rules — padding token usage, label spacing, and min-height rules. Action: update component master for Table Row and Chart Legend.
2025-02-26 Oliver Chan: Opened PR to update token-export adapter: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design-system/pull/828 — includes mapping table and fallback behavior for aliases.

2025-03-01 Maya Rojas: Published draft library v0.9.0 (unlisted). Sharing link and migration guide: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DS/pages/8923456-Token-Consolidation-Plan — Next: request signoff from Platform team.

2025-03-02 Maya Rojas: Updated migration checklist to include explicit code snippets for token fallback and example CSS variables.
notes: Migration strategy: two-week alias phase, automated linter to detect deprecated tokens, and a small engineering patch to read alias map on startup.
Risk: immediate hard rename will cause multiple frontend regressions. Mitigation: provide backward-compatible aliasing and coordinate rollout windows with team leads.
Follow-ups: create 'token-deprecation' dashboard and tag teams that use deprecated tokens for direct outreach.
